title: Installable web app: manifest and install button
when: The user wants the site to be installable as an app, with an icon, a name and its own window.
prompt:
Goal: A valid web app manifest, icons, and an install button that appears only when installing is possible.
Steps:
1. manifest.json: name, short_name (12 characters or fewer), description, id, start_url "./", scope "./", display "standalone", background_color, theme_color, lang.
2. Icons: 192 and 512 px PNG plus a 512 px maskable one with the logo inside the central 80 percent, each with sizes, type and purpose.
3. In head: <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json"> and <meta name="theme-color">.
4. Installability also needs HTTPS or localhost and a service worker with a fetch handler.
5. Install button: on beforeinstallprompt call preventDefault(), keep the event, reveal a hidden <button type="button">; on click call prompt() and await userChoice; hide on appinstalled.
6. Adjust standalone mode with @media (display-mode: standalone).
Quality bar:
- Name and colors match the site.
- Maskable icons are not cropped.
- The install button never shows when install is impossible.
Pitfalls:
- Manifest paths that break in subfolders.
- A single tiny icon.
- An install popup on first load.
Verify:
- [ ] manifest.json parses with name, icons, start_url and display.
- [ ] Manifest link in head.
- [ ] A service worker is registered.
- [ ] Install button starts hidden.
Output: manifest.json, icons/ folder, head links in index.html and install.js.

examples.input: quero que dê para instalar meu app no celular
examples.output: manifest.json with name, short_name, standalone, 192/512 and maskable icons, hidden Install button
